integrity: The theorem proof uses Kummer borrow counts, exact digital transition identities and analytic coefficient comparison. Included finite checks are reproducibility aids, not a substitute for an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform sharp first and second minima within a single p-adic digit-length block; does not give higher-ranked minima, large-range frequency laws, or independent validation.
title: Sharp second minima of prime-power nonzero counts on Pascal-row blocks
